When reporting an issue

  • Include your PawTale version, iOS version, and iPhone model.
  • Tell us what screen you were on, how to reproduce the problem, what you expected, and what happened.
  • Cover names, phone numbers, and other private details before sharing a screenshot. Keep full backups private.

For help with notifications, photos, or imports, see Troubleshooting.
